note: Held-out route test set written by Claude (an AI assistant, working as a subagent) on 2026-09-21 from the task brief alone; the author had not seen the classifier's code, rules, or any other fixture. Labelling policy: each goal gets the cheapest route that fully and safely does it - a bare launch of one installed app or a concrete web search is a reflex (with astra added when more is asked), anything consequential, any typing/writing, and any question or read-the-screen request is planner-only (astra), and everything else is lane. When a case was genuinely ambiguous the safer route was chosen (planner-only over lane over reflex) and the 'why' field says so.
